law.catch_line: Implied warranty; merchantability of computer program

text.section: the program is adequately packaged and labeled as the agreement requires; and

in the case of multiple copies, the copies are within the variations permitted by the agreement, of even kind, quality, and quantity within each unit and among all units involved; and
that the program conforms to any promises or affirmations of fact made on the container or label.
Unless disclaimed or modified, other implied warranties with respect to computer programs may arise from course of dealing or usage of trade.
No warranty is created under this section with respect to informational content, but an implied warranty may arise under § 59.1-504.4.
